lore_anchors.definition: A legendary spirit insect known for its near-indestructible golden carapace and ability to devour almost any material; Han Li’s batch has mutated after consuming too many Iron Fire Ants, now bearing black stripes.
Mysterious colorful spheres that provide a subtle, long-term boost to a cultivator’s qi absorption and conversion efficiency; their exact origin is unknown, but they are clearly beneficial.
A spiritual herb believed to stimulate reproduction in high-grade demon beasts when fed at the right growth stage; its effectiveness is not guaranteed.
A rare spirit-insect species known for producing valuable silk; Han Li’s batch dies out after a failed reproduction attempt, producing only dead eggs.
